argocd.description: Track Helm chart pins inside ArgoCD Application/ApplicationSet manifests (e.g. kube-prometheus-stack in argocd/*/apps.yaml). The argocd manager ships disabled — it has no default file patterns — so this block is what makes those pins visible at all.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch updates for container images
Never auto-merge a Helm chart bump — charts carry CRDs and values-schema changes, and prod runs with skipCrds: true so CRDs are applied by hand
Pin latest tags to digests for reproducibility
Block major upgrades for stateful services (require manual DB migration)
